title: Skyline Showdown
tagline: Two gorillas, a city at dusk and a lot of exploding bananas.
pitch: Two gorillas face off across the rooftops. Pick an angle, feel the wind and lob an exploding banana over the city. Every miss blows a hole in the skyline and teaches you something; the first clean hit brings the house down. Then take the World Tour, from Jakarta to the eye of Jupiter's storm, play the day's city that everyone on Earth is playing, or crack twenty-four one-throw puzzles.
highlights: Learn it in one throw, master it in the wind
A World Tour of fifteen stops, each with a twist and a rival
A Daily Skyline for the whole planet, 24 Trick Shot puzzles, and shots to send as links
Play a friend on one keyboard or a CPU at four levels, in sixty things to wear

screens.caption: Fifteen stops, from Jakarta to the eye of the storm.
Pull back, read the wind, let it fly.
Trick Shot: one throw, one puzzle, as many tries as you like.
Every miss leaves its mark on the skyline.
On the Moon, a banana floats for ages.
The Daily Skyline: one city a day, the same for everyone.
Dress your gorilla from a wardrobe of sixty items.
Or settle it in broad daylight.

title: Donkey Dash
tagline: One button, two lanes and a great many donkeys.
pitch: There is a donkey in the road, and it is not moving. Press once to switch lanes, just as in 1981, then take the long way round: a Road Trip across five routes, an Endless road that keeps getting faster, a Daily Road everyone drives the same, and a mode where a friend gets to be the donkey.
highlights: One button: the whole game fits under a thumb
Chase, top-down or isometric: three views, all equally fair
Road Trip, Endless, a Daily Road and the 1981 duel
Two players on one screen: a friend picks the donkey's lane

screens.caption: A donkey over the hill, and carrots in the lane.
BOOM! The 1981 crash, four halves and all.
Or watch the road as a tiny model world.
Top-down like 1981, with headlights at night.
Five routes, from the farm to the snow.
Donkey vs Driver: a friend decides where it goes.

title: Long Haul
tagline: Los Angeles to New York, and every mile is money against time.
pitch: Monday, 8 AM: oranges in the trailer, 190 gallons in the tank and Thursday's deadline 2,850 miles away. Choose the road, the speed, the stops and the sleep, an hour at a time, as in the original; then take an old rig into a Career across nineteen cities, or drive the Daily Haul everyone gets the same.
highlights: The original rules, routes and verdicts, bugs fixed
Real time or leg by leg, from the cab or side on
Truck stops, a CB full of tips and 351 postcards
Single Haul, a Career and a Daily Haul

screens.caption: Across the red mesas, a truck stop sign ahead.
From the cab: the gauges, the CB and the atlas on the dash.
A diner at night, neon lit, the rig at the pump.
The full map: the trail so far and the weather drifting east.
At the dock, the logbook, the receipts and the verdict.
Or play it as it was: green text, an hour at a time.
